# American Airlines is ready to bring customers together this Thanksgiving


[(English) (opens in new window) PDF 150 KB](https://s202.q4cdn.com/986123435/files/doc_news/American-Airlines-is-ready-to-bring-customers-together-this-Thanksgiving-OPS-OTH-11-2026.pdf)


FORT WORTH, Texas — As millions of customers prepare to gather with family and friends this Thanksgiving, American Airlines is ready to help make those important connections possible and deliver a safe, reliable operation across its global network.


Nov. 19 through Dec. 1, American and its regional partners expect to welcome more than 8 million customers across nearly 85,000 flights, including 7,021 flights on Sunday, Nov. 29 — the airline’s largest operating day since the pandemic. Across the airline, team members have spent months preparing for the holiday rush, from fine-tuning schedules and resources to strengthening the technology and tools that help keep the operation running smoothly.


"Thanksgiving is about bringing people closer to family, friends and traditions," said American's Chief Operating Officer David Seymour. "Our team is ready for one of the busiest travel periods of the year, and we're focused on delivering a safe, reliable operation so our customers can spend less time thinking about holiday travel and more time enjoying the holiday."


### American’s 2026 Thanksgiving operation by the numbers


Nearly 85,000 flights: American and its regional partners will operate nearly **85,000** flights, up 4% from 2025.


More than **8 million** customers: That’s enough to fill more than **1 million** Thanksgiving tables with eight guests each or fill every seat on an American Boeing 737 — one of the birds in its flock — more than **46,000** times.


The busiest day: American plans to operate **7,021** flights on Sunday, Nov. 29, its largest single day of flying since the pandemic.


A takeoff every **13** seconds: That’s about the time it takes to pour a cup of coffee, and American will have another flight in the air.


The schedule includes quick trips, like Miami (MIA) to Bimini, Bahamas (BIM), at **64** miles, and long-haul flights, such as Dallas Fort Worth (DFW) to Brisbane, Australia (BNE), at **8,299** miles.


1,130 flights at once: At 11 a.m. CT on Nov. 20, 29 and 30, American will have **1,130** flights operating simultaneously, all supported by a team of nearly 500 people on duty at any given time at[American’s Integrated Operations Center](https://news.aa.com/ioc/) .


While Thanksgiving is one of the busiest travel periods of the year, it is also one of the most rewarding. Every day, American's team members work behind the scenes to help customers reunite with loved ones, celebrate traditions and create new and lasting memories.


### Delivering for customers


Since last Thanksgiving, American has continued investing in the people, technology and experiences that make travel easier and more enjoyable. This holiday season, customers can look forward to:


- **Finding their preferred seat with less work:** Eligible AAdvantage® members can[set their seat preferences](https://news.aa.com/news/news-details/2026/New-American-Airlines-app-feature-monitors-seat-availability-based-on-customers-preferences-MKG-OTH-09/default.aspx) in the American app and let it automatically move them when a preferred seat becomes available.
- **Staying connected for free:** AAdvantage® members can stay connected with[free high-speed Wi-Fi](https://news.aa.com/news/news-details/2026/American-Airlines-launches-FREE-high-speed-Wi-Fi-sponsored-by-ATT-available-on-more-aircraft-than-any-other-carrier-in-the-world/default.aspx) , sponsored by AT&T, on nearly every American flight.
- **More to enjoy on board:** Customers can enjoy new complimentary[Main Cabin snacks](https://news.aa.com/news/news-details/2026/Boarding-soon-American-Airlines-to-elevate-the-inflight-experience-with-new-lineup-of-complimentary-snacks-MKG-OB-08/default.aspx) , including Goldfish crackers and Tate’s cookies, where eligible.
- **Saving on checked bags:** Customers can save $5 on eligible checked bags by paying ahead on aa.com or the American app.
- **More ways to earn:** Enhanced Citi® / AAdvantage® cards offer[new ways](https://news.aa.com/news/news-details/2026/American-and-Citi-enhance-the-Citi-AAdvantage-Platinum-Select-World-Elite-Mastercard-and-the-Citi-AAdvantage-Business-World-Elite-Mastercard-with-more-ways-to-earn-and-new-travel-benefits-AADV-10/default.aspx) to earn miles and enjoy travel benefits.
- **More flexibility with miles:** Eligible members can now combine[cash and miles](https://news.aa.com/news/news-details/2026/American-Airlines-launches-cash-and-miles-bookings-giving-AAdvantage-members-more-flexibility-to-redeem-rewards-AADV-10/default.aspx) when booking flights, providing more flexibility to use their rewards.
- **More deals on the way:** Travelers can look to American for Cyber Week and Travel Tuesday offers to help inspire their next getaway.


"Whether customers are traveling across the country or around the world, we want every part of their journey to feel easier and more convenient," said American’s Chief Customer Officer Heather Garboden. “From finding the right seat to staying connected in the air, these enhancements give customers more ways to personalize their travel experience.”


Customers can make holiday travel easier by checking in through the American app, monitoring flight status before heading to the airport and allowing extra time for busy airports and security checkpoints, where eligible customers at participating airports are encouraged to use[TSA PreCheck Touchless ID](https://news.aa.com/news/news-details/2026/American-Airlines-and-TSA-expand-TSA-PreCheck-Touchless-ID-to-all-of-Americans-hub-airports-OPS-OTH-04/default.aspx) . Customers can also use the app to track checked bags, receive real-time travel updates and stay connected throughout their journey.


###### About American Airlines Group (NASDAQ: AAL)


American Airlines is a premium global airline connecting more of the U.S. to the world. With roots tracing back to an air mail carrier in the Midwestern United States in 1926, American now operates more than 6,000 daily flights to more than 350 destinations in more than 60 countries and serves more than 200 million customers annually. Powered by a proud and talented team of 130,000 aviation professionals, American’s team lives out the airline’s purpose of caring for people on life’s journey every day.


The world’s largest airline proudly celebrates its centennial year in 2026, reaching a milestone that reflects a century of innovation and the Forever ForwardSM spirit that changed the industry and the world. American introduced the first scheduled air cargo service, the first airport lounge and the first airline loyalty program and continues to reinvent the customer experience today. The airline is also a founding member of the **one** world alliance, whose members serve more than 900 destinations around the globe.


Get the latest about American at[news.aa.com](https://news.aa.com/) and[@AmericanAir](https://x.com/AmericanAir) .
